entry.title: googleapis/google-cloud-dotnet - Releases - 2025-11-17
entry.content:
Google.Shopping.Merchant.Products.V1 version 1.3.0

New features

  • Added the product_id_base64_url_encoded field to InsertProductInputRequest, DeleteProductInputRequest, and GetProductRequest. This allows for product IDs containing special characters to be correctly handled when unpadded base64url-encoded
  • Added several fields to enhance shipping configurations:

Documentation improvements

  • Updated various comments, including links to data source creation guides

Google.Shopping.Merchant.Quota.V1 version 1.2.0

New features

  • Add the AccountLimit resource and its service to the quota bundle

Google.Shopping.Merchant.IssueResolution.V1 version 1.2.0

New features

  • Added the product_id_base64_url_encoded field to RenderProductIssuesRequest. This allows for product IDs containing special characters to be correctly handled when unpadded base64url-encoded
  • Added VERIFY_BUSINESS_VIDEO_IN_MERCHANT_CENTER as a new enum value to ExternalAction.Type. This supports redirecting to Merchant Center for business video verification

Google.Shopping.Merchant.Inventories.V1 version 1.2.0

New features

  • Added the product_id_base64_url_encoded field to ListLocalInventoriesRequest, InsertLocalInventoryRequest, DeleteLocalInventoryRequest, ListRegionalInventoriesRequest, InsertRegionalInventoryRequest, and DeleteRegionalInventoryRequest. This allows for product IDs containing special characters to be correctly handled when unpadded base64url-encoded

Google.Shopping.Merchant.IssueResolution.V1Beta version 1.0.0-beta05

New features

  • Added the product_id_base64_url_encoded field to RenderProductIssuesRequest. This allows for product IDs containing special characters to be correctly handled when unpadded base64url-encoded
  • Added VERIFY_BUSINESS_VIDEO_IN_MERCHANT_CENTER as a new enum value to ExternalAction.Type. This supports redirecting to Merchant Center for business video verification

Google.Cloud.Spanner version 5.7.0

New features

  • Add Send and Ack mutations for Queues
  • Add QueryAdvisorResult for query plan

Documentation improvements

  • Update description for the BatchCreateSessionsRequest and Session
  • Update description for the IsolationLevel

Google.Shopping.Merchant.Products.V1Beta version 1.0.0-beta07

New features

  • Added the product_id_base64_url_encoded field to InsertProductInputRequest, DeleteProductInputRequest, and GetProductRequest. This allows for product IDs containing special characters to be correctly handled when unpadded base64url-encoded
  • Added handling_cutoff_time and handling_cutoff_timezone fields to the Shipping message within Attributes
  • Added C#, PHP, and Ruby namespace options to ProductInputs, Products, and ProductsCommon proto files for improved client library generation

Documentation improvements

  • Updated comments for several fields, including product name formats, data source creation, destination field descriptions (now also referred to as Marketing Methods), and the default page size for ListProductsRequest

Google.Shopping.Merchant.Inventories.V1Beta version 1.0.0-beta08

New features

  • Added the product_id_base64_url_encoded field to ListLocalInventoriesRequest, InsertLocalInventoryRequest, DeleteLocalInventoryRequest, ListRegionalInventoriesRequest, InsertRegionalInventoryRequest, and DeleteRegionalInventoryRequest. This allows for product IDs containing special characters to be correctly handled when base64url-encoded
  • Added C#, PHP, and Ruby namespace options to LocalInventory and RegionalInventory proto files for improved client library generation

Documentation improvements

  • Updated the API summary and overview in the service configuration
